links.comparator_used: GPT-4o with the reference knowledge supplied directly in the prompt (no RAG), and GPT-4o without the reference knowledge
links.outcome: Lung cancer staging accuracy on 100 fictional cases
links.effect: NotebookLM (RAG) 86% accuracy vs GPT-4o 39% with REK in prompt and 25% without REK
